debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output (includes all log levels)

hardware.description: Include hardware inventory (CPU, memory, disks, etc.)

interval.description: Time (in seconds) between automatic inventory runs

local_inventory.description: Write inventory to local files instead of sending to server (when `no-server = 1`)

localdir.description: Directory to store local inventory files

log_to_syslog.description: Send logs to system syslog in addition to file

network.description: Include network interfaces and IP configuration

no_server.description: Run in local-only mode (no server communication); output written to `localdir`

registry.description: Enable Windows registry scanning (ignored on Linux)

server.description: FusionInventory server URL (or local mode with `no-server = 1`)

servers.description: List of FusionInventory servers to report inventory to (supports multiple)

ca_bundle.description: Optional path to custom CA bundle (PEM format); leaves blank to use system CA store

enabled.description: Enable this server (set to `false` to disable reporting)

name.description: Unique identifier for this server entry

password.description: Password for authentication with this server (store securely)

ssl_verify.description: Verify SSL certificates for HTTPS connections (set to `false` only with self-signed certs)

url.description: Base URL of the FusionInventory server (e.g., http://fusioninventory.example.com:62353)

username.description: Username for authentication with this server

snmp.description: Enable SNMP scanning of local/network devices (requires additional setup)

tags.description: Custom inventory tags as key-value pairs (e.g., environment=production)

virtualization.description: Include virtualization guests/containers inventory (e.g., Docker, LXC)

wmi.description: Enable WMI queries on Windows (ignored on Linux)
